scopeGuards.computedImports: Computed import/require/asset expressions are hashed and counted but cannot be resolved without runtime values.
scopeGuards.frameworkGeneratedCode: Next.js route manifests, generated Prisma code, package postinstall output, and Trigger build transforms are not recoverable from import syntax alone.
scopeGuards.generatedPrisma: Bare @prisma/client imports resolve to generated/package runtime code outside the raw source tree. prisma/schema.prisma is pinned as an evidence root, not as proof of generated-client byte identity.
scopeGuards.runtimeData: Database rows, environment values, remote prompt/config services, filesystem reads not represented as literal new URL(..., import.meta.url), and package-internal runtime data are outside this static closure.
scopeGuards.sourceInputNotRuntimeBundle: This closure is over Vercel's raw deployment source inputs. Production executes compiled output under out/, whose module graph may differ after bundling and tree-shaking.
